definitions.explanation: A brief, general description of something without going into full detail. Used to provide the main points or gist of a topic.

examples.japanese: {概略|がいりゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{概略|がいりゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the overview of the project.

examples.japanese: {概略|がいりゃく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}して→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧おきたい。
examples.english: I want to at least grasp the general outline.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{概|がい} (general, approximate) + ⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ (abbreviation, summary)

USAGE:
Used in business and academic contexts when:
- Giving a high-level overview
- Summarizing complex topics
- Providing initial explanations

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概略|がいりゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧ - to state an outline
- {概略|がいりゃく}⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ - summary explanation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{概要|がいよう}→概要：06747_gaiyou⟧ - summary, overview
- ⟦{大筋|おおすじ}→大筋：07287_oosuji⟧ - general outline
